description: Search file contents with a regex pattern. Default output_mode is files_with_matches (file paths only); use content mode for matching lines with context. Prefer this over shell grep for ordinary workspace searches. Binary and file-size limits are enforced by the tool; explicit file paths use a larger bounded limit than directory searches. Supports glob/type filtering.

function.description: Search file contents with a regex pattern. Default output_mode is files_with_matches (file paths only); use content mode for matching lines with context. Prefer this over shell grep for ordinary workspace searches. Binary and file-size limits are enforced by the tool; explicit file paths use a larger bounded limit than directory searches. function.name: grep

context_after.description: Number of lines of context after each match

context_before.description: Number of lines of context before each match

fixed_strings.description: Treat pattern as plain text instead of regex (default false)

head_limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. In content mode this limits matching line blocks; in other modes it limits file entries. Default 250

max_matches.description: Legacy alias for head_limit in content mode

max_results.description: Legacy alias for head_limit in files_with_matches or count mode

offset.description: Skip the first N results before applying head_limit

output_mode.description: content: matching lines with optional context; files_with_matches: only matching file paths; count: matching line counts per file. Default: files_with_matches

path.description: File or directory to search in (default '.')

pattern.description: Regex or plain text pattern to search for
